messages:
raj: quick heads-up — did a rapid audit-coverage heatmap for API gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. big gaps in billing export events and runtime container lifecycle traces. sharing notes and proposed handoffs :eyes:
tess: can you paste the heatmap link? want to cite it in the sprint ticket.
raj: https://internal.redwood/heatmaps/audit-coverage-170412 (private) — highlights: api-gateway: missing request.body_hash & route_id in some proxied flows; auth: ok for token grants but missing session.invalidate for SSO logout; console: missing policy_change entries for role edits; billing: missing invoice.export and refund.reason; runtime: no container.start/stop events tied to customer_id in k8s autoscale path.
kevin: noted. priority for compliance customers will be billing + runtime. can we scope quick wins into the next patch?
olivia: I'll take billing. will add `invoice.export` and `refund.processed` events to billing-worker and ensure they include `actor_id`, `customer_id`, `invoice_id`, and `request_id`.
mira: i'll own runtime side. plan: add `container.lifecycle` event with `action: start|stop|evict`, include `customer_id`, `node_id`, `image`, `reason`. low overhead.
raj: good. also we found schema inconsistencies — some services use `user_id` vs `actor_id`, and `kms_key` vs `kms_key_id`. let's standardize before exposing to customers.
kevin: propose a small canonical audit schema snippet and a validation step in CI. quick example to standardize on:
```json
{
  "event_type": "string",
  "timestamp": "iso8601",
  "actor_id": "string",
  "customer_id": "string",
  "resource": "string",
  "action": "string",
  "request_id": "string",
  "metadata": {"kms_key_id": "string"} 
}
```
mira: small ask — metadata nested object is fine, but audit ingestion currently flattens fields. if we add `metadata.kms_key_id` we need backwards compat flag.
raj: agreed. add a migration plan: 1) accept both `kms_key` and `kms_key_id` for 2 sprints with normalization in pipeline, 2) start emitting `actor_id` everywhere, 3) add schema checks in staging ingest.
tess: can we create customer-facing validation tests? i.e., unit tests that run sample events against the schema and a short note for Support on what events we guarantee for Enterprise customers.
olivia: yes, i'll add tests and a small doc snippet for support.
sec-bot: Reminder: new audit events touching billing must be approved by compliance before deploy. See https://internal.redwood/policies/audit-events.
kevin: ok owners: olivia -> billing ticket #CN-521, mira -> runtime ticket #CN-522, raj -> coordinate schema changes + CI check. i'll draft a short rollback plan in case ingestion fails (route to cold storage).
raj: thanks. action items captured. i'll drop a short triage doc and assign in backlog. ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
